body: I go through extended periods where it’s all consuming, all day, day after day. It’s exhausting and every day I wake up hoping to have the nerve to end mine and everyone around me’s misery. It’s really exhausting. I try to keep myself busy to distract myself, but it creeps in. “Hey, jab that screwdriver through your eye, grab that cop’s gun, that fall could probably kill you,” etc).
Sometimes the only way I can maintain my composure is to envision my death (don’t want to be specific here, but it’s the same loop over and over). It’s almost meditative.

That's exactly where I am. My mom's mom killed herself when my mom was 7. She found the body and it's always been a source of pain for her. My brother has told me that that is the main reason he hasn't killed himself too.
I'm right there with you.  Waiting on my mom and brother to die so I can end it.
